jobs.title: Clinical Database Programmer
jobs.description:
Job Summary :

Our global business is growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, office-based Clinical Database Programmer to join our Data Management team in our London office. The position will work in a team to develop databases in which clinical data is captured and processed for analysis and reporting. This position plays a critical role on our study teams and quality, timely database development is instrumental to the company’s success. If you are interested in an exciting career where you have the opportunity to use your knowledge and expertise and can develop and grow your career even further, then this is the position for you!

Responsibilities :

* Coordinate with Data Managers to develop and maintain clinical study electronic data capture (EDC) databases according to company and/or sponsor standards;
* Perform quality checks and validation testing in collaboration with colleagues in order to deliver a quality product to our Sponsors;
* Gain and strengthen knowledge in the industry and in multiple electronic data capture systems;
* Be an active member of multiple global project teams, and collaborate across several different functional areas.

Qualifications :

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematical science, life science or related field;
* Basic level experience in at least one programming language;
* Rave and/or C# or similar programming experience preferred, but not required;
* Flexible and able to support a variety of studies;
* Meticulous attention to detail

Medpace Overview :

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace? :

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

***Purpose-Driven Work***

* + Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

***Collaborative Culture***

* + Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
  + Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

***Continuous Growth & Development***

* + Office based environment with on-site mentors
  + Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
  + Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
  + Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
  + An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

***Other Employee Benefits***

* + Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
  + Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
  + Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
  + Company-sponsored social events

*Please note benefits may vary based on country.*

**What to Expect Next**

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

jobs.title: Senior / Principle Engineer Operations · Cambi UK office
jobs.description:
**Would you like to use your skills to accelerate the global transition to a low-carbon circular economy?**

**About Cambi**

Cambi is a world-leading provider of sustainable technology solutions that enable cities to turn wastewater sludge into valuable resources. We are a medium-size, Norway-based multinational company listed in Oslo on Euronext Growth, with offices in several countries. We have diligent employees from different backgrounds and more than 25 nationalities, and a growing sales network covering all continents.

Our core expertise lies in designing, testing, manufacturing, installing, and operating industrial process installations, used mainly for treating sewage sludge before or after anaerobic digestion in wastewater treatment plants. The technology, known as thermal hydrolysis, reduces greenhouse gas emissions and produces renewable energy, organic fertilizers, and various soil products while destroying pathogens and other harmful substances. Our systems have the capacity to cater to over 120 million individuals across more than 28 countries. We are proud of having cities like Oslo, London, Washington, Singapore, and Sydney among our clients.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Senior / Principal Engineer to lead our mechanical engineering function, delivering high-quality technical solutions that meet customer requirements, project objectives, and industry standards.

As a Senior / Principal Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across complex engineering projects, acting as a key point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders. You will play a critical role in driving engineering excellence, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, safety, and quality.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong engineering professional who enjoys leading teams, mentoring others, and solving complex engineering challenges within a highly regulated industry environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage mechanical engineering teams in the successful delivery of complex engineering projects.
* Provide technical leadership and oversight to ensure high-quality engineering solutions are delivered on time and to specification.
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers, supporting their technical growth and professional development.
* Act as a primary technical liaison for customers and internal stakeholders, building strong relationships and maintaining effective communication throughout project lifecycles.
* Review, approve, and sign off engineering calculations, specifications, design packages, and technical reports.
* Ensure all engineering activities comply with relevant legislation, industry regulations, codes, and standards.
* Support customer engagement activities, technical discussions, issue resolution, and business development initiatives.
* Apply advanced engineering expertise to resolve complex mechanical and structural challenges.
* Drive continuous improvement of engineering processes, procedures, standards, and systems.
* Promote the highest standards of safety, quality, technical integrity, and operational performance across all projects.

**We Are Looking For**

* A proven engineering leader with the ability to lead teams and deliver complex technical projects.
* Strong experience in mechanical design within a regulated industry environment.
* A collaborative professional who can build effective relationships with customers, colleagues, and stakeholders at all levels.
* An individual who thrives on solving complex engineering problems and delivering practical, innovative solutions.
* A mentor and coach who is passionate about developing engineering talent and promoting best practices.
* Someone with excellent communication skills and the ability to present technical information clearly and effectively.

*Wastewater industry experience would be advantageous but is not essential. We welcome applications from candidates working in any regulated industry sector.*

**Key Qualifications and Requirements**

**Essential**

* Degree in Engineering (or equivalent) within a relevant discipline.
* Chartered Engineer (CEng) status.
* Significant and demonstrable experience delivering mechanical design solutions within a process plant or regulated industry environment.
* Proven experience leading engineering teams and delivering complex technical projects to time, cost, and quality requirements.
* Strong knowledge of BS, EN, AISC, ASTM, ASME and other relevant engineering codes and standards.
* Sound understanding of engineering mechanics and static/dynamic structural behaviour.
* Experience producing, reviewing, and approving detailed engineering deliverables, including calculations, specifications, and technical reports.
* Experience developing and maintaining engineering procedures, standards, and systems.
* Strong customer-facing experience, including technical support, issue resolution, and stakeholder management.
* Broad technical knowledge of mechanical equipment, technologies, and engineering principles.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in structural engineering software, including STAAD.Pro.
* Experience using SolidWorks Simulation or equivalent FEA software for modelling and analysis.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working to EN and ASME Codes, particularly relating to vessels and piping.

**Personal Attributes**

* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Logical and methodical approach to work.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to influence, motivate, and inspire engineering teams to achieve outstanding results.

At Cambi, we value people who share our commitment to the environment and the positive impact of the circular economy. Your personality should align with Cambi’s core philosophy, which centers around strong customer focus, delivering a high standard of quality in our solutions, products, and services, and always acting with integrity.

**Why Join Cambi**

* **Work globally:** Encounter different cultures and work practices when working with the global organization.
* **Make an impact:** Contribute to projects transforming organic waste streams into bioresources, boosting the circular economy, and leading to net-zero emissions in cities worldwide.
* **Immerse in diversity:** Join a multicultural team with a mix of young and experienced colleagues from more than 25 countries and 18 different disciplinary backgrounds.
* **Grow personally:** Embrace our values: quality, curious, reliable and teamwork, in a dynamic work environment grounded in a modern Code of Conduct applying to all employees and business partners.

**How to Apply**

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career with us, we’d love to hear from you. We kindly ask you to upload your CV and answer three questions regarding your motivation for the role.

Delivering on our mission to enable a swift global transition to sustainable communities is contingent on attracting and retaining talented employees from diverse backgrounds.

Please be informed that we will only accept and assess applications through our career site.

Employment with the company is subject to proof of the right to work in the UK. All applicants will be considered based on merit and assessed in accordance with UK right-to-work legislation.

**Contact**

For any questions about the role, you’re welcome to get in touch with:

Marc Decker, Marc.Decker@cambi.com

jobs.title: VP Software Engineering, Asset Management Solutions
jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

The Vice President, Software Engineering will lead the technology strategy, engineering delivery, and modernization of Asset Management Solutions. This leader will manage an organization of approximately 60–70 engineering professionals while remaining hands-on in technology, platform architecture, and delivery decisions.

The role is responsible for transforming legacy applications and migrating capabilities to an integrated, scalable platform. The VP will drive adoption of AI-enabled tools and practices, strengthen engineering execution, and ensure the technology roadmap aligns with evolving buy-side market needs and client expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and inspire a team of 60–70 software engineering professionals, managers, and technical leaders.
* Define and execute the engineering strategy and technology roadmap for Asset Management Solutions.
* Drive the modernization and transformation of legacy applications, including migration to an integrated platform architecture.
* Remain actively engaged in technical decisions involving application architecture, platform strategy, integration, scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
* Partner with product, business, operations, and technology leaders to prioritize investments and deliver solutions aligned with client and market needs.
* Identify and advance opportunities to embed AI across the software development lifecycle, engineering operations, and business-facing solutions.
* Establish modern engineering practices across Agile delivery, software quality, testing, release management, observability, and production support.
* Apply knowledge of buy-side business trends, workflows, and technology needs to shape platform capabilities and modernization priorities.
* Lead organizational and technology change initiatives, communicating a clear vision and creating alignment across stakeholders.
* Influence senior leaders, engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to build commitment and drive execution against strategic priorities.
* Establish clear performance metrics, delivery governance, and accountability for engineering quality, platform stability, modernization progress, and business outcomes.
* Recruit, develop, and retain strong engineering talent while fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Deep experience in Buy Side OMS and Asset Management
* Significant leadership experience in software engineering, application development, platform engineering, or technology transformation.
* Demonstrated success leading engineering organizations of substantial scale, including managers, architects, and software development teams.
* Deep technical knowledge of software architecture, enterprise applications, APIs, Kafka, Java, C#, cloud platforms, systems integration, and modern software delivery practices.
* Proven experience modernizing legacy applications and migrating technology capabilities to integrated, scalable platforms.
* Experience driving technology transformation, organizational change, and adoption of new engineering practices.
* Strong understanding of AI adoption, including the use of AI tools across the software development lifecycle and in business-facing technology solutions.
* Knowledge of the asset management and buy-side technology landscape, including market trends, workflows, and evolving client needs.
* Ability to operate as a hands-on technology leader while setting strategy and leading through a large organization.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build followership, align diverse teams, and lead complex change initiatives through execution.

**Leadership Profile**

The successful candidate is a strategic, technically credible leader who can balance modernization with day-to-day delivery. They will bring a strong point of view on platform transformation and AI adoption, while building trust with engineering teams and business stakeholders. This individual will be able to influence at all levels of the organization, create alignment around a shared vision, and lead teams through meaningful technology and organizational change.

*Salary range $275,,000.00- $300,000.00 USD. Bonus Eligible.*

*Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.*

*Please visit* *www.broadridgebenefits.com* *for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings*.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Location

Aberdeen, United Kingdom

Category

Engineering

Date Published

30/09/26

Status

Open

**About the job:**

Kent is looking for a Graduate Software Engineer to be based in Aberdeen.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference and engineer solutions that make not only the UK’s energy security stronger but actively impact the way in which the world drives towards a net zero future?

Our Engineering & Consulting Software Development team works closely with our clients to develop high-quality software solutions that add real value to their operations. By combining high-end technical knowledge with modern software development, the team provides its clients with the tools needed to efficiently and reliably solve many of the Energy industry’s technical challenges, across a wide range of disciplines. As a graduate in our team, you will be working on intelligent and useful software to support some of the most challenging engineering projects, helping shape the future of energy. You will get involved in the full software development lifecycle, solving exciting challenges and growing into a high-quality software engineer.

**About our Graduate Scheme**

Our people are our power. At Kent, diverse perspectives and talents are the backbone of our strength. We’re building an environment where everyone, from engineers to scientists, from all walks of life, can thrive and reach their full potential.

If you’re passionate about making an impact and pushing boundaries, Kent is where you belong. We are a future-focused company, reimagining energy with ambition and innovation.

Our global graduate program offers hands-on experience, mentorship from industry leaders, and the opportunity to grow as part of a diverse and driven team. We’re building the next generation of leaders in engineering, science, and technology, and we want you to be a part of it.

**Application Process**

As part of the application process, candidates will be required to provide confirmation of the academic modules completed during their university studies. This information will help us assess the relevance of your academic background to the role. Please ensure that confirmation of your completed modules is submitted alongside your CV as part of your application.

**Application Deadline**

All applications must be received by **Friday 23****rd** **October 2026**.

**Recruitment Timeline**

Shortlisting and pre-screening of applications will commence in early November. Candidates selected to progress to the next stage will be invited to interview, with interviews scheduled to take place from late November to early December 2026.

**Eligibility**

Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.

**Hybrid Working**

We follow a hybrid working model that combines office and remote work, with a requirement to be in the offices three days a week. This approach supports the development of a strong and effective team dynamic.

**Power the future with us. Unleash your energy**

**Skills & Responsibilities:**

As a software developer joining our Engineering & Consulting Software Development team, you will:

* Become an integral part of a growing team, collaborating with your colleagues to develop, deliver and support a variety of innovative software solutions that meet clients’ requirements within time and budget constraints.

* Get involved in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering, design and implementation, through to testing, deployment, maintenance and support. We use a lean and agile methodology, giving you the opportunity to grow into a well-rounded developer, and allowing you to have an impact on every stage of a project.

* Deliver bespoke software applications using a range of modern technologies and platforms, from desktop applications and services to web and cloud solutions and Microsoft Office automation. The team will help you continuously improve your programming skills, learn new things and keep up to date with the latest developments in the industry.

* Solve logical and algorithmic problems, review them with the wider team, and implement these solutions into working software features.

* Learn and adhere to our software engineering standards, procedures and best practices, and provide suggestions for continuous improvements.

* Build and configure test environments and carry out unit and factory acceptance tests for our developed applications.

* Produce relevant user documentation and deployment guides.

* Provide support to our clients, both external and internal, for our growing portfolio of software products.

* Help deploy software applications and systems and provide training to end users when required.

* Be part of an excellent working environment, collaborating with technical experts across various domains and disciplines to produce software of the highest quality standards.

Our technology stack is mostly Microsoft-based: we develop software using .NET and Visual Studio, primarily in C#, but also VB.NET for legacy applications. We use Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) and legacy WinForms for our desktop apps, ASP.NET and Angular for web development, SQL Server and Azure for data. We also use Python for various data analytics or scripting solutions. You will also get to develop clever macros using VBA to help our engineering teams become more efficient and save time through automation. All of these will be supported by using Artificial Intelligence, particularly Large Language Models, to increase our development efficiency, so you will be gaining more experience with using some of the latest models.

In addition to the responsibilities listed herein, the employee may be required to perform other ad-hoc tasks as needed or directed by the supervisor or management. These tasks will be within the reasonable scope of the employee's skills, capabilities, and role within the organization. The intent of this provision is to allow for flexibility and adaptability in meeting the dynamic needs of the organization, ensuring that operational requirements can be met efficiently. All such tasks will be assigned considering the employee's current workload and with respect to their professional development.

**Your knowledge/skills, education, and experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or similar / related field).

* Experience in software development, preferably using .NET (C# or VB.NET) or Python, gained through work experience, degree coursework or self-study. Ideally, you will have used .NET, SQL in the past and have experience with desktop and web development (preferably with some of WPF, WinForms, ASP.NET MVC and WebAPI, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, but not essential). We will help you constantly improve your skills and become a great developer, as long as you are passionate about technology, software development, and artificial intelligence, and willing to learn and adapt to the rapid pace of the industry.

* Understanding of software development principles and strong commitment to delivering to high quality standards, constantly looking for innovation and improvements, whilst futureproofing your work

**Communication:**

* Excellent command of the English language in both oral and written communication and skills.

**Behaviour/ Core Competencies:**

* Technically minded with strong analytical and logical problem-solving skills. A passion for solving difficult challenges, and persistence are desirable.

* Able to work in an agile environment, adapting to various domains and coping with uncertainty and changing requirements.

* Ability to work in a team, across a variety of projects and technologies and to prioritise workload, ensuring that quality and timeliness of deliverables is met.

* Creativity and strong communication skills for both business and technical audiences.

* A practical mind and being self-motivated, hard-working and reliable.

* We are looking for candidates who are due to graduate in 2027, or have graduated in the last 2 years.

**HSSEQ:**

The Employee shall observe the Health, Safety, Sustainability, Environment and Quality rules of the Company; it’s clients and the governing authorities of the host country.

We are committed to our diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop. From day one, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, and employee networks to support staff from different backgrounds.

As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities.

We’re a disability-friendly employer and can make adjustments to support you to perform at your best during the recruitment process. Please contact us confidentially at recruitment.uk@kentplc.com to find out how we can support you.
